title: Heart rate
text: Rest sitting for five minutes, then count the pulse at the wrist for 30 seconds and double it, or use a validated monitor. A normal resting rate for adults is roughly 60 to 100 beats per minute.
A rate of 111 to 130 scores watch and 131 or above, or 40 or below, scores critical under NEWS2 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017). Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

citations.source: NEWS2 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017): single-parameter scores for heart rate.
